title: Largest authorisations at each public body
question: Who holds the biggest contracts at the public bodies whose spending is not in the City’s ledger?
finding: 4,508 board items of seven bodies were read, 2,498 with a dollar figure; the largest single authorisation naming a firm is $863.9 million to Halmar International, LLC (Golden Gate Bridge district).
how: For each body, the six largest items of $1 million or more whose vendor text reads as a firm name; other public agencies are left out. Amounts are as parsed from the item.
limits: These are board agenda items and resolutions: a ceiling the board was asked to authorise, not a payment, and the dollar figure is the first one a parser found in the text. An item on an agenda may have been amended or withdrawn. Each body is legally separate from the City. Vendor names were cut out of free text and are missing or wrong on many rows, so this is a sample of large items, not a ranking of vendors. School-district agenda titles rarely state an amount, so the district does not appear; its spending is the largest gap in this table.
